display_long_description:
**SMASH EAT GROW**

The ravenous Smashers have come to Earth to PLAY with their FOOD! 

Become a Smasher, beam down to Earth, and eat everything you see! If it’s too big to fit in your mouth - SMASH it! The more you EAT, the more you GROW, so get eating, get bigger, and FIGHT other Smashers to become the BIGGEST and the BEST! 
[media]

**I WANT TO SMASH STUFF!**

Who doesn’t? We’ve got you covered! ALL-STAR SMASH is an all-against-all rumble to find and eat delicious STARS - but first, you need to GROW big to SMASH through their force fields. And other Smashers want the stars as well, so be ready to FIGHT!

Grab stuff! Throw stuff! Bash stuff with stuff! Grab Smashers! Throw Smashers! EAT your FRIENDS! 

It’s everyone against everyone in PURE VR CHAOS! 
[media]

**I WANT TO CUSTOMIZE!**

Of course you do! Luckily, every Smasher flying saucer has its own SHOP. Because if you’re a planet eating space monster, you’re gonna need a SHOP! Earn BUX to buy, wear and show off your smashing fashion!

[media]

**I WANT MORE!**

We all do! Smashers ALWAYS WANT MORE! So come see our Discord, join the Smasher Fleet, and tell us what YOU want! (Hint - it’s MORE!).

https://discord.gg/gpcPrZUGup

Then keep coming back to see what’s new! New food! New weapons! New customizations! New modes! New maps! New ways to SMASH EAT GROW!

Join the FUN in a PLAYGROUND of DESTRUCTION! LET’S GROW!
